sentences.l2: 中世ヨーロッパで発展したゴシック様式の大聖堂は、その圧倒的な高さと美しさで人々を魅了しました。
sentences.l1: Gothic cathedrals, which developed in medieval Europe, fascinated people with their overwhelming height and beauty.

sentences.l2: この建設には、当時の建築工学の知恵が結集されています。
sentences.l1: The wisdom of the architectural engineering of the time was brought together in their construction.

sentences.l2: 特に注目すべきは、天井の重量を分散させる「リブ・ヴォールト」と、壁の外側から支える「フライング・バットレス」と呼ばれる技術です。
sentences.l1: Particularly noteworthy are the techniques called the "rib vault," which distributes the weight of the ceiling, and the "flying buttress," which supports from the outside of the wall.

sentences.l2: これらにより、壁を薄くして大きな窓を設けることが可能となり、内部は光に満ちあふれました。
sentences.l1: Thanks to these, it became possible to make the walls thin and provide large windows, and the interior was filled with light.
